attributes.name: Jaruunicka
attributes.powers:
Before you act, succeed at an Arcane or Divine 9 check or you may not play spells that have the Attack trait.

When you are dealt damage by Jaruunicka, first choose blessings to discard as your damage, if you have any. Then draw as many cards as you discarded and recharge that number of cards.
